The selection model and action set are right. “Select all in this view” should affect exactly the current tab and search results, never hidden bookmarks outside that scope.

For bulk tag changes, I’d prefer the same existing-tag suggestions used when saving a bookmark. For removal especially, show tags that actually occur on the selected bookmarks so I don’t have to remember or retype them exactly. With that adjustment, the bulk flow matches what I need.
